title: DojoLiq Fizzy Cherry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Capture the joy of sparkling fruit beverages with Vaporesso DojoLiq Fizzy Cherry. The vape begins with the rich, bold sweetness of ripe red Cherry, delivering a deeply satisfying fruit base. As the flavour develops, a fun and effervescent fizz emerges, echoing the sparkling sensation of a popular soda. It is a lively and refreshing profile that brings excitement to every draw. To ensure peak performance, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid features a finely tuned 45% VG / 55% PG ratio specifically optimised for this blend. This bespoke formulation guarantees rapid wicking and maximum flavour transmission when used with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod systems and starter vape kits. The Nicotine Salt blend ensures a gentle throat feel and fast-acting nicotine relief. Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
